{{Short description|Russian-American mathematician}}
{{distinguish|text=the mathematician Yuri A. Kuznetsov at [[Utrecht University]]}}
'''Yuri A. Kuznetsov''' is a Russian-American mathematician currently the M. D. Anderson Chair Professor of Mathematics at [[University of Houston]] and Editor-in-Chief of ''[[Journal of Numerical Mathematics]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.math.uh.edu/~kuz/ |title=Yuri A. Kuznetsov |publisher=uh.edu |access-date=May 10, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.inm.ras.ru/yk60/yk60_rjnamm.html |title=Yuri Kuznetsov |publisher=ras.ru |access-date=May 10, 2017}}</ref>
